description: Declarative OpenMetadata lineage for custom non-dbt ingestion, OLTP integration, recommendation workflows, and warehouse loading paths in the Enterprise Real Estate Intelligence Platform.

lineage_edges.description: Generated search records are transformed from raw.recherches into typed and quality-controlled staging.recherches by database/seeds/transform_raw_to_staging.py.
Generated property listings are transformed from raw.annonces into typed and quality-controlled staging.annonces by database/seeds/transform_raw_to_staging.py.
Validated generated searches from staging.recherches create or reuse operational demande records through database/seeds/load_staging_recherches_to_oltp.py.
Validated generated searches from staging.recherches are loaded into demande_version with generated-search lineage fields through database/seeds/load_staging_recherches_to_oltp.py.
Validated generated listings from staging.annonces are upserted into operational real_estate.bien through database/seeds/load_staging_to_oltp.py.
Operational source reference data is loaded into warehouse.dim_source by database/olap/load_warehouse.py::load_dim_source.
Operational client records are loaded into warehouse.dim_client by database/olap/load_warehouse.py::load_dim_client.
Operational hunter records are loaded into warehouse.dim_chasseur by database/olap/load_warehouse.py::load_dim_chasseur.
Operational sector records are loaded into warehouse.dim_secteur by database/olap/load_warehouse.py::load_dim_secteur.
Operational demand versions are loaded into warehouse.dim_demande_version by database/olap/load_warehouse.py::load_dim_demande_version.
Operational property records are loaded into warehouse.dim_bien by database/olap/load_warehouse.py::load_dim_bien.
Property geographical attributes are used to populate warehouse.dim_localisation by database/olap/load_warehouse.py::load_dim_localisation.
Operational property data supplies business measures and source identifiers when loading warehouse.fact_annonce.
warehouse.dim_bien supplies the property surrogate key used by warehouse.fact_annonce.
warehouse.dim_source supplies the source surrogate key used by warehouse.fact_annonce.
warehouse.dim_localisation supplies the geographical surrogate key used by warehouse.fact_annonce.
Operational mandate records provide the business measures and identifiers loaded into warehouse.fact_mandat.
warehouse.dim_client supplies the client surrogate key used by warehouse.fact_mandat.
warehouse.dim_chasseur supplies the hunter surrogate key used by warehouse.fact_mandat.
Operational mandate-sector associations are loaded into warehouse.bridge_mandat_secteur.
warehouse.fact_mandat supplies the mandate fact key used by warehouse.bridge_mandat_secteur.
warehouse.dim_secteur supplies the sector surrogate key used by warehouse.bridge_mandat_secteur.

The production recommendation workflow loads the selected demand version as matching input and persists Top-N deterministic recommendations as real_estate.presentation records through src/api/services/recommendation.py.

Eligible operational properties are filtered, scored and ranked by the production recommendation workflow, and selected Top-N properties are persisted as real_estate.presentation records through src/api/services/recommendation.py.
Operational presentation records are loaded into warehouse.fact_presentation by database/olap/load_warehouse.py::load_fact_presentation.
Demand-version context is joined when loading warehouse.fact_presentation.
Demand records provide mandate linkage used during fact_presentation loading.
Mandate is an optional upstream dependency used to resolve client and hunter dimensions.
Property records are joined to resolve the warehouse property dimension during fact_presentation loading.
Warehouse demand-version dimension supplies the surrogate key used by fact_presentation.
Warehouse property dimension supplies the surrogate key used by fact_presentation.
Warehouse client dimension optionally supplies the client surrogate key; UNKNOWN key 0 is used when no mandate/client exists.
Warehouse hunter dimension optionally supplies the hunter surrogate key; UNKNOWN key 0 is used when no mandate/hunter exists.
Operational payment records provide the business measures and identifiers loaded into warehouse.fact_paiement.
Operational mandate data provides client and hunter relationships required while loading warehouse.fact_paiement.
warehouse.fact_mandat supplies the mandate fact key used by warehouse.fact_paiement.
warehouse.dim_client supplies the client surrogate key used by warehouse.fact_paiement.
warehouse.dim_chasseur supplies the hunter surrogate key used by warehouse.fact_paiement.

staging.recherches supplies the explicit sector relationship or lookup used by real_estate.demande_version_secteur. Missing property sectors remain unmapped; postal codes alone do not assign a sector.

real_estate.demande_version supplies the explicit sector relationship or lookup used by real_estate.demande_version_secteur. Missing property sectors remain unmapped; postal codes alone do not assign a sector.

real_estate.secteur supplies the explicit sector relationship or lookup used by real_estate.demande_version_secteur. Missing property sectors remain unmapped; postal codes alone do not assign a sector.
real_estate.secteur supplies the explicit sector relationship or lookup used by real_estate.bien. Missing property sectors remain unmapped; postal codes alone do not assign a sector.

real_estate.demande_version_secteur supplies the explicit sector relationship or lookup used by warehouse.bridge_demande_version_secteur. Missing property sectors remain unmapped; postal codes alone do not assign a sector.

warehouse.dim_demande_version supplies the explicit sector relationship or lookup used by warehouse.bridge_demande_version_secteur. Missing property sectors remain unmapped; postal codes alone do not assign a sector.

warehouse.dim_secteur supplies the explicit sector relationship or lookup used by warehouse.bridge_demande_version_secteur. Missing property sectors remain unmapped; postal codes alone do not assign a sector.
warehouse.dim_secteur supplies the explicit sector relationship or lookup used by warehouse.dim_bien. Missing property sectors remain unmapped; postal codes alone do not assign a sector.
